meaning: to treat someone to a meal or drink

english.note: Use 請 as the all-purpose spoken choice for inviting someone over, treating them to something, or politely asking people to do something.

exampleSentences.english: I’ll invite you for a cup of coffee.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ceng2 nei5 jam2 bui1 gaa3 fe1

english.note: Use this when buying something means treating someone to a meal, drink, or gift.

exampleSentences.english: This time, I’ll buy you dinner.
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ngo5 ceng2 nei5 sik6 faan6
